metaDescription: Order custom heat transfer underwear, robes, and sleepwear for your team. Soft, durable decoration for bulk orders at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Heat transfer decoration gives you crisp, full-color logos on soft fabrics without the stiffness of embroidery. For custom underwear, robes, and sleepwear, this method preserves the garment's comfort while adding vibrant branding. Perfect for corporate gifts, hospitality uniforms, or promotional giveaways where you want a smooth, wearable design that won't fade after washing.
